comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: Well when you consider that no crest has any boosters and all they do is take up an inventory slot, they do not offer any benefit whatsoever (knight's crest excluded). They aren't worth anything unless you find that rare player who does not care about his/her inventory and likes it purely for it's aesthetics.

comments.author: Ming Mei
comments.body: You'll be surprised how many players are willing to pay good amounts of ducats and use up inv slots just for looks. Well crest, most of us have one anyway, but people out there actually buy clothes with no bonuses just because they think their toons look cool in them.
